items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: We're going to Madisonville with Reuben McClendon, Sadie, and Reuben Eugen was there.

ctx.x: Oh, really? Oh, really? Oh, really? You were going to tell me about that? Oh, really?

Oh, that's what I'm saying. This is- I was really young. I was really young. We're going to Madisonville with Reuben McClendon, Sadie, and Reuben Eugen was there. And Robert Davis. He's a saxophonist? He was- Robert Davis was a drummer.
Reuben McClendon, but banjo, he was playing banjo at that time. And Sadie on piano.
